description: This file defines the BestImagePlugin class, which implements logic to select the best available recipe image from various sources, including HTML meta tags and schema data. It includes methods for normalizing image entries, collecting candidates, scoring and selecting the best image based on size and security, and parsing image dimensions from URLs or metadata.

classes.name: BestImagePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for selecting the best recipe image based on size and other criteria, implementing the PluginInterface.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Decorator method that wraps a function to add image selection logic, including candidate collection and best candidate selection.

methods.name: _collect_candidates
methods.description: Collects image candidates from primary image data, schema data, and OpenGraph meta tags.

methods.name: _normalize_entries
methods.description: Normalizes various formats of image entries into a standard dictionary with URL, width, and height.

methods.name: _collect_opengraph_candidates
methods.description: Extracts image candidates from OpenGraph meta tags in the HTML soup.

methods.name: _merge_candidate
methods.description: Merges a candidate image into the candidates list, updating size and source information.

methods.name: _max_dimension
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two dimension values.

methods.name: _parse_dimension
methods.description: Parses a dimension value from string, number, or dict formats.

methods.name: _select_best_candidate
methods.description: Selects the best candidate based on size, security, and order.

methods.name: _score_candidate
methods.description: Scores a candidate image based on area, security (HTTPS), and insertion order.

methods.name: _ensure_dimensions
methods.description: Ensures width and height are set for a candidate, extracting from URL if necessary.

methods.name: _extract_dimensions_from_url
methods.description: Extracts image dimensions from URL patterns or query parameters.

methods.name: _find_query_dimension
methods.description: Finds dimension values in URL query parameters.
